SINGLEPLAYERCARD-IRONCLAD_CARDS.title: Ironclad Cards
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-DEMONIC_SHIELD.title: Demonic Shield
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-DEMONIC_SHIELD.hover.de:
[Adjusted] Lose 1 HP. Gain Block equal to the HP you've lost this combat. Exhaust (except on Upgrade).
[Original] Lose 1 HP. Double your Block. Exhaust (except on Upgrade).
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-TANK.title: Tank
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-TANK.hover.desc:
[Adjusted] Take 50% more damage from enemies. Reflect all blocked Attack damage back at the attacker.
* The Original effect doesn't work correctly in singleplayer, so it isn't offered here.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-MIDNIGHT.title: Midnight
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-MIDNIGHT.hover.desc:
[Adjusted] Deal 42 damage. Costs 1 less for each card in your Discard Pile. Costs 2 less this turn for each card Exhausted this turn.
[Original] Deal 60 damage. Costs 1 less for each card Exhausted this combat.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-BLAZE.title: Blaze
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-BLAZE.hover.desc:
[Adjusted] Gain 2 Strength for each card you've discarded this turn.
[Original] Gain 5 Strength.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-OUTRAGE.title: Outrage
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-OUTRAGE.hover.desc:
[Adjusted] Deal 8 damage. Add a copy of this card and any copies in your hand to your Discard Pile.
[Original] Deal 9 damage. Add a copy of this card to your Discard Pile.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-SILENT_CARDS.title: Silent Cards
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-PINCER_ATTACK.title: Flanking
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-PINCER_ATTACK.hover.des:
[Adjusted] This turn, the enemy takes double damage from Attack cards not currently in your hand.
[Original] This turn, the enemy takes double Attack damage.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-STEALTH.title: Sneaky
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-STEALTH.hover.desc:
[Adjusted] Sly. Whenever you deal damage by means other than an Attack card, gain 1 Block.
[Original] Sly. Whenever you attack an enemy, gain 1 Block.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-BLADE_SYMPHONY.title: Blade Symphony
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-BLADE_SYMPHONY.hover.de:
[Adjusted] Play every Shiv you generated this turn (Upgraded).
[Original] Add 2 Shivs to your hand.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-CONCOCT.title: Concoct
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-CONCOCT.hover.desc:
[Adjusted] Give all un-enchanted Attack cards in your hand Venomous 1.
[Original] This turn, whenever an Attack deals unblocked damage, apply 3 Poison.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-SHADOW_VANISH.title: Fade
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-SHADOW_VANISH.hover.des:
[Adjusted] Retain. This turn, gain Dexterity equal to the number of non-Skill cards in your hand. Exhaust (except on Upgrade).
[Original] Retain. This turn, gain 6 Dexterity.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-REGENT_CARDS.title: Regent Cards
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-GENEROUS_GIFT.title: Largesse
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-GENEROUS_GIFT.hover.des:
[Adjusted] At the start of your next turn, add 1 random Colorless card to your hand.
[Original] Add 1 random Colorless card to your hand.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-HAMMER_TIME.title: Hammer Time
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-HAMMER_TIME.hover.desc:
[Adjusted] Whenever you play Sovereign Blade, replay every card that Forged this turn.
* The Original effect doesn't work correctly in singleplayer, so it isn't offered here.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-SCHEME.title: Plot
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-SCHEME.hover.desc:
[Adjusted] Lose the extra card you'd draw at the start of next turn, and draw it now instead.
[Original] Next turn, draw 2 cards.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-CONSTELLATION.title: Constellation
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-CONSTELLATION.hover.des:
[Adjusted] At the start of your next turn, draw a card, gain 1 Energy, and gain 9 Block.
[Original] Draw a card, gain 1 Energy, and gain 9 Block.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-TUTOR.title: Tutor
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-TUTOR.hover.desc:
[Adjusted] Choose a card in your Draw Pile to add to your hand.
* This card's Adjusted and Original effects are identical, so there's no separate option for it.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-NECROBINDER_CARDS.title: Necrobinder Cards
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-BONE_LEGION.title: Legion of Bone
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-BONE_LEGION.hover.desc:
[Adjusted] Summon 5 for each enemy. Exhaust.
[Original] Summon 6. Exhaust.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-GLIMPSE_BEYOND.title: Glimpse Beyond
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-GLIMPSE_BEYOND.hover.de:
[Adjusted] At the start of your next 2 turns, add a Soul to your hand. Exhaust.
[Original] Add 3 Souls to your Draw Pile. Exhaust.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-UNDERWORLD.title: Underworld
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-UNDERWORLD.hover.desc:
[Adjusted] This turn, whenever you apply Doom, deal damage equal to that amount. Exhaust (except on Upgrade).
[Original] This turn, whenever an Attack deals damage, apply Doom equal to that damage. Exhaust (except on Upgrade).
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-CACOPHONY.title: Cacophony
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-CACOPHONY.hover.desc:
[Adjusted] Every 12 cards drawn, deal 16 damage to a random enemy.
[Original] Every 33 cards drawn, deal 66 damage to a random enemy.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-DEFECT_CARDS.title: Defect Cards
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-ENERGY_SURGE.title: Energy Surge
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-ENERGY_SURGE.hover.desc:
[Adjusted] At the start of each of your next 2 turns, gain 1 Energy. Exhaust.
[Original] Gain 2 Energy. Exhaust.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-IGNITION.title: Ignition
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-IGNITION.hover.desc:
[Adjusted] Channel 1 Plasma. Trigger the Passive of all Plasma orbs. Exhaust (except on Upgrade).
[Original] Channel 1 Plasma. Exhaust (except on Upgrade).
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-HIBERNATE.title: Hibernate
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-HIBERNATE.hover.desc:
[Adjusted] At the end of this turn, your Frost triggers its Passive twice. Channel 2 Frost.
[Original] Channel 2 Frost.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-ONE_FOR_ALL.title: One for All
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-ONE_FOR_ALL.hover.desc:
[Adjusted] Your 0 Energy Attacks deal 3 additional damage.
* This card's Adjusted and Original effects are identical, so there's no separate option for it.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-IMITATION_LEARNING.hove:
[Adjusted] At the end of each of your next 2 turns, play a copy of the last Power you played.
[Original] The next 2 Powers you play are played an extra time.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-COLORLESS_CARDS.title: Colorless Cards
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-GANG_UP.title: Gang Up
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-GANG_UP.hover.desc:
[Adjusted] Deal 10 damage. This turn, replay every other Attack card you've played on this enemy.
[Original] Deal 5 damage. Deal 5 additional damage for each Attack you've played this turn.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-TAG_TEAM.title: Tag Team
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-TAG_TEAM.hover.desc:
[Adjusted] Deal 11 damage. The next Attack you play on the enemy is played an extra time.
* This card's Adjusted and Original effects are identical, so there's no separate option for it.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-KNOCKDOWN.title: Knockdown
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-KNOCKDOWN.hover.desc:
[Adjusted] Deal 10 damage. Next turn, the enemy takes double damage.
[Original] Deal 10 damage. This turn, the enemy takes double damage.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-THE_BALL.title: The Ball
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-THE_BALL.hover.desc:
[Adjusted] Deal 10 damage. Increase this card's damage by 5 this combat and shuffle it into a random spot in your Draw Pile, Hand, or Discard Pile.
[Original] Deal 10 damage. Increase this card's damage by 10 this combat and add it to your Draw Pile.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-BELIEVE_IN_YOU.title: Believe in You
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-BELIEVE_IN_YOU.hover.de:
[Adjusted] Next turn, once you've played an Attack, a Skill, and a Power, gain 1 Energy.
[Original] Gain 2 Energy.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-INTERCEPT.title: Intercept
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-INTERCEPT.hover.desc:
[Adjusted] Gain 10 Block. Gain 1 Weak.
* The Original effect doesn't work correctly in singleplayer, so it isn't offered here.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-WAR_COUNCIL.title: Huddle Up
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-WAR_COUNCIL.hover.desc:
[Adjusted] Draw 2 cards. At the start of your next turn, draw 2 more cards.
[Original] Draw 2 cards. Exhaust.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-HELPING_HAND.title: Lift
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-HELPING_HAND.hover.desc:
[Adjusted] Double the Block gained from your next card.
[Original] Gain 11 Block.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-COORDINATE.title: Coordinate
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-COORDINATE.hover.desc:
[Adjusted] This turn, gain Strength equal to the number of cards in your hand.
[Original] Until end of turn, gain 5 Strength.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-MIMICRY.title: Mimic
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-MIMICRY.hover.desc:
[Adjusted] Gain Block equal to the highest Block value among cards in your hand (ignoring special effects). Exhaust (except on Upgrade).
* The Original effect doesn't work correctly in singleplayer, so it isn't offered here.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-GATHER.title: Rally
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-GATHER.hover.desc:
[Adjusted] Gain Block equal to the sum of the Block values of all other cards in your hand (ignoring special effects).
[Original] Gain 12 Block.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-BEACON_OF_HOPE.title: Beacon of Hope
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-BEACON_OF_HOPE.hover.de:
[Adjusted] Innate. At the end of your turn, gain half the Block you gained that turn at the start of your next turn.
* The Original effect doesn't work correctly in singleplayer, so it isn't offered here.
